abilities.effect: The haunt makes a spectral bolt Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Rain of Bolts
abilities.trigger: A creature attacks the graveknights in area G1 or enters the castle

abilities.effect: The haunt makes a spectral bolt Strike against the triggering creature.
abilities.name: Continuous Barrage
abilities.trigger: A creature in front of the gate finishes an action

hazard.description: Ghostly soldiers wielding crossbows manifest within the towers that flank the gatehouse and rain bolts down upon intruders.
hazard.disable: DC 31 Intimidation (expert) to cow the archers into fleeing or DC 28 Religion (expert) to temporarily banish the spirits
hazard.name: Spectral Archers
hazard.reset: The haunt vanishes permanently if the graveknights are destroyed. Otherwise, it returns after 1 hour.
hazard.routine: (1 action) The hazard fires one bolt at every creature in a 30-foot-by-30-foot area in front of the gate as 1 action. Because the spectral archers fire bolts continuously, the haunt can also use the Continuous Barrage free action (below) to fire bolts at each creature during that creature's turn.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
